notes.title: The first open beta of "Cub Story" has released
notes.notes:
🌟 [Cubs Story] First Playtest  is LIVE! 🌟

Hey future Cubs parents! 🐾

[b]Test Focus:[/b]
🔧 Core gameplay validation
👗 Outfit preference analysis
🛠 Technical stability checks

📢 Key Details
✅ Test Period: Starts Feb 21, 2025[i] (3-7 days duration based on stability)[/i]
✅ Platform: Steam
⚠️ Important: Progress will be wiped after testing

🎮 Gameplay Preview
Cubs Story is a cozy desktop idle game blending dress-up and virtual pet raising. Current features include:
🐾 Companion Mode
Nourish your pet with snacks 🍩
Customize outfits & accessories 👒
Choose exploration styles:
• Roaming: Active adventures → Unique rewards
• AFK Mode: Passive rewards while you work/study

🏡 Home Decor Mode
Design dream rooms 🖼️
Interactive feeding & grooming
Unlock furniture through gameplay

💬 Your Voice Matters!
Join our Chinese Community: QQ Group 206663996
✨ While the game is silent, your feedback speaks volumes! 
🐱Let's shape "Cubs Story" by  Idling together! 💬
